bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Builds Released - New updates enhance user experience and fix critical issues across channels.
Gaming Copilot Beta Launch - AI-powered recommendations and insights are rolling out for Windows PC and Xbox users.
Microsoft Defender ROI Surges - A Forrester study reveals a 242% ROI for organizations using Microsoft Defender.
Microsoft 365 Copilot Enhancements - New collaborative agents introduced to improve teamwork and productivity.
AI Datacenter Expansion Announced - New AI datacenters in the US and UK to support advanced AI workloads.
Windows 365 Updates for Cloud Productivity - Enhancements made to streamline management and security for users.
